name: @pr-quest/server
description: PR Quest's local API: GitHub and Linear polling, game state and review runs

scripts.build: node -e "fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && esbuild src/main.ts src/app/server.ts src/app/db.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --splitting --outdir=dist --entry-names='[name]' --external:@cursor/sdk --external:@anthropic-ai/sdk --external:pg --sourcemap --log-level=warning
